title: Builders in Fintech: Fintech Funding Rounds, Companies and Investors
description: Editorially curated, sourced dataset of fintech funding rounds worldwide, with companies, investors and attributed facts from the Builders in Fintech podcast. Public export of the Builders in Fintech database (https://buildersinfintech.ai). Amounts are stored in the currency announced and never converted. Coverage from November 2023, refreshed weekly; each monthly release is archived here. Methodology: https://buildersinfintech.ai/methodology
